editorial: Today, the artificial intelligence ecosystem is expanding with tools focusing on personal AI infrastructure and skill management. The architectural diagrams shared by Daniel Miessler and the skill libraries published by Google reveal the effort to standardize the working principles of autonomous agents.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.summary: Last30days-skill offers an artificial intelligence skill (AI agent skill) that creates synthesized summaries about certain topics by scanning current data from platforms such as Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News and Polymarket. This Python-based tool combines information obtained from different sources and provides the user with an evidence-based summary.

items.title: RyanCodrai/turbovec
items.summary: Built on TurboQuant and developed with the Rust language, Turbovec offers fast vector indexing thanks to Python bindings. This library aims to optimize vector-based data structures for high-performance search operations.

items.title: google/skills
items.summary: The skills library developed by Google offers Python-based tools that enable artificial intelligence agents to interact with Google products and technologies. This resource provides the functionality necessary for agents to perform specific tasks in a standardized structure.

items.title: refactoringhq/tolaria
items.summary: Tolaria is a desktop app developed for managing Markdown-based knowledge bases. Written in TypeScript, this tool offers interface support for organizing personal documentation processes.

items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.summary: Agent-Reach is a command line interface (CLI) tool that gives AI agents the ability to scan and read various platforms on the internet. It makes it possible to pull data from popular networks like Twitter, Reddit, and GitHub without paying any application programming interface (API) fees.

items.title: danielmiessler/Personal_AI_Infrastructure
items.summary: Personal artificial intelligence infrastructure (Personal AI Infrastructure) includes agent-based artificial intelligence (agent AI) systems designed to expand individual capabilities. This structure, developed with the TypeScript language, allows users to manage their own automation processes and smart workflows.

items.title: santifer/career-ops
items.summary: Using the Claude Code infrastructure, career-ops automates artificial intelligence-supported job search processes with 14 different skill modes. The system provides the opportunity to perform batch processing and create a CV in PDF format through a control panel written in Go language.

items.title: phuryn/pm-skills
items.summary: PM Skills Marketplace offers more than 100 agentic skills, commands and plugins developed for product management processes. This resource aims to standardize AI-powered workflows across the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to growth.

items.title: openai/plugins
items.summary: OpenAI plugins provide an extensibility architecture that enables language models to access external data and perform real-time operations. This structure allows artificial intelligence models to increase their functionality by interacting with third-party applications.

items.title: Andyyyy64/whichllm
items.summary: Whichllm is a tool that allows you to identify the native large language models that perform best on your hardware. Focusing on current benchmarks rather than the number of parameters, this Python-based software allows you to choose the most suitable model with a single command.

items.title: MemPalace/mempalace
items.summary: MemPalace offers an open source and high-performance memory system for artificial intelligence models. With this Python-based library, developers can provide efficient data storage and retrieval capabilities to artificial intelligence applications.

items.title: roboflow/supervision
items.summary: Developed by Roboflow, Supervision offers reusable auxiliary tools and functions for computer vision projects. This Python-based library accelerates development workflows by facilitating standard operations in processes such as object detection and tracking.

items.title: CopilotKit/CopilotKit
items.summary: CopilotKit provides the frontend stack required to create artificial intelligence agents and generative user interfaces (generative UI). It uses the AG-UI protocol, which allows developers to develop agent-based interactive interfaces on React, Angular, and mobile platforms.

items.title: TapXWorld/ChinaTextbook
items.summary: The ChinaTextbook project provides an archive of textbooks used in the Chinese education system from primary school to university level in PDF format. This open source repository brings together access to academic resources in a digital library structure.

items.title: luongnv89/claude-howto
items.summary: This visual guide for Claude Code offers a wide range of examples, from basic concepts to advanced agent configurations. It aims to speed up users' coding processes and standardize application development practices through copyable templates.

items.title: aaif-goose/goose
items.summary: Developed with the Rust language, Goose is an open source artificial intelligence agent (AI agent) that goes beyond code suggestions and automates software installation, execution, editing and testing processes. This extensible structure, which can integrate with any major language model (LLM), aims to manage development workflows end-to-end.

items.title: Show HN: Performative-UI – A react component library of design tropes
items.summary: Performative-UI offers design tropes frequently used in user interface design as ready-made React components. Thanks to this library, developers can quickly integrate common visual patterns into their projects.

items.title: Anti-social: It's fads, not friends, which now dominate social media feeds
items.summary: Social media platforms have ceased to be areas where users interact with their friends and have turned into channels dominated by fads and algorithmic content. This change took the basic function of social networks to a different dimension, as personal connections were replaced by content consumption.

items.title: MiMo-v2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed: 1T model with 1000 tokens per second
items.summary: Developed by Xiaomi, MiMo-v2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed ​​was introduced as a large language model with 1 trillion parameters that offers a generation speed of 1000 tokens per second. This technology aims to expand real-time interaction capacity by increasing the inference speed in high-scale models.

items.title: Siri AI
items.summary: With Apple Intelligence, Apple is updating Siri with generative AI models that understand personal context and can perform cross-application operations. This system aims to provide a more advanced digital assistant experience by protecting the privacy of user data through on-device processing and cloud-based private servers.

items.title: Apple reveals new AI architecture built around Google Gemini models
items.summary: By integrating its artificial intelligence architecture with Google Gemini models, Apple is moving it to a new structure that combines on-device and cloud-based operations. This architecture aims to provide a more advanced artificial intelligence experience throughout the system by combining Apple's own hardware capabilities with Google's large language models.

items.title: nvidia/LocateAnything-3B
items.summary: Developed by NVIDIA, LocateAnything-3D is an image-text-to-text model that performs object localization tasks by processing visual and textual inputs. The model is designed to identify objects in visual content and present the coordinates of these objects with text-based outputs.

items.title: google/gemma-4-12B-it
items.summary: Gemma-2-11B-it, an updated version of the Gemma 2-9B model developed by Google, is an anything-to-any conversion model with multi-modal capabilities. This model processes text and visual data simultaneously, providing the capacity to produce interactive output between different data types.

items.title: unsloth/gemma-4-12b-it-GGUF
items.summary: The Gemma-4-12b-it model, optimized by Unsloth, offers a multimodal structure that can process visual and text data. Thanks to the GGUF format, the model accelerates text-based visual analysis processes on local devices by using hardware resources efficiently.

items.title: google/gemma-4-12B
items.summary: Developed by Google, Gemma-4-12B offers a multi-modal (any-to-any) model structure that can process different data types. This model can be used in a wide range of tasks by supporting flexible conversion processes between text and other data formats.

items.title: ideogram-ai/ideogram-4-fp8
items.summary: ideogram-4-fp8, developed by Ideogram, is a model used in text-to-image processes. Optimized with floating point precision 8-bit (FP8) format, this model aims to increase visual production performance.
